title: Merge or clearly disambiguate epic_24_stop_bleeding_test.dart and epic_24_stop_the_bleeding_test.dart; make test-epic-24 run both

evidence.quote: /// Story acceptance tests for Epic 24 -- Stop-the-Bleeding (Phase 0).
/// Story acceptance tests for Epic 24 — Stop-the-Bleeding (Phase 0).
test-epic-24: ## Run all Epic 24 (Stop-the-Bleeding) acceptance tests

why: make test-epic-24's own doc-comment claims to run 'all Epic 24' tests but only executes epic_24_stop_bleeding_test.dart (Stories 24.7/24.8); Stories 24.1 and 24.4's 423 lines of tests, living in the near-identically-named epic_24_stop_the_bleeding_test.dart, are silently excluded, and there is no test-story-24.1/test-story-24.4 target at all. A developer following CLAUDE.md's documented loop ('Run make test-epic-N to check you didn't break sibling stories') gets a false all-clear for 24.1/24.4 while iterating on 24.7/24.8. Git history confirms this isn't an in-progress rename: both files were independently created the same day (2026-05-13) by different work streams (DNI-310 vs DNI-316/319), each assuming it owned 'the' epic-24 file -- the exact 'divergent parallel copy' failure mode AG-4/AG-5's rationale warns about. (The tests still execute under `make ci` -> `flutter test --coverage`'s whole-directory discovery, so the CI hard gate itself isn't bypassed -- only the convenience per-epic/per-story targets are broken.)
recommendation: Rename/merge into one canonical, clearly-named file (or split by story with unambiguous suffixes the way epic_25+ do, e.g. epic_24_story_24_1_rules_test.dart), then add test-story-24.1/test-story-24.4 Makefile targets and fix test-epic-24 to cover all four stories.
acceptance_criteria: `make test-epic-24` output shows Stories 24.1, 24.4, 24.7, and 24.8 all executing
Only one file (or a story-suffixed set) matches `test/story_acceptance/epic_24_*_test.dart` with no name differing from another only by an article/qualifier word
mergedFrom: Remove the hardcoded personal PATH and silenced stderr in emit-fixtures
